Name: Adventure Time Lady Rainicorn Horse
Author: thornsby
Description:
This mod turns the basic horse into Lady Rainicorn from Adventure Time!

Install instructions:
1. back up your original horse.xnb file
2. copy this horse.xnb file, and paste it into Stardew Valley/Content/Animals

Downloads.Description: Turns the vanilla horse into Lady Rainicorn from Adventure Time!
